discovery: Prior Dream Cycle nights (2026-08-13 through 2026-08-16) all concluded this checker was 'not applicable, a library not a CLI' and fell back to a manual STEP 11 checklist only. Tonight, control-plane discovery went one level deeper: `ruvector harness darwin`'s CLI action lazily dynamic-imports @metaharness/darwin and (per the same module, ruvector/dist/metaharness/index.js) @metaharness/weight-eft is ALSO importable the same way even though no CLI subcommand wires it up. This is a real capability the CLI surface doesn't expose — recorded here so future Dream Cycle nights don't have to rediscover it.
scope_caveat: detectRewardHack(trajectory) reads only trajectory.messages[].tool_calls (OpenAI-style {function:{name,arguments}}), matching gold-read/verification-tamper/sandbox-escape regexes against tool NAME + arguments text. It recognizes read_file/edit_file/write_file/etc. by name; a 'bash' tool call is NOT scanned for gold-read patterns (only tool names matching /file|path|patch/i trigger the pattern scan) — a real scope limitation of this monitor for a session that used Bash for some file operations (git show, running the benchmark). Disclosed rather than hidden.
trajectory_construction: Tonight's actual Read/Edit/Write/Bash tool calls touching v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory/ewc-consolidation.ts and the new benchmark/test files were mapped into the tool's expected {role:'assistant', tool_calls:[{function:{name, arguments}}]} schema (read_file/edit_file/write_file/bash) — a good-faith representative trajectory of this candidate's actual file operations, not a synthetic or cherry-picked one.
